study type: Prospective, longitudinal, single-arm, postmarket surveillance study with comparison to historical data
exposure: Use of t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ technology
cohort: The study included 3157 individuals aged 6 years and older with type 1 diabetes who began using the t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ technology.
finding: Users of t:slim X2 with Control-IQ technology experienced significantly lower rates of severe hypoglycemia and diabetic ketoacidosis compared to historical data for both adults and children.
